articles.summary: BEIJING, Aug. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Autohome Inc. (NYSE: ATHM; HKEX: 2518) (" Autohome " or the "Company"), the leading online destination for automobile consumers in China, today announced its unaudited financial results for the three months and six months ended June 30, 2026.
articles.title: Autohome Inc. Announces Unaudited Second Quarter and Interim 2026 Financial Results
